notes: Gap for the owner: the design says lines are paged in the workspace, with a 2-second target at 10,000 lines (R52, Failure modes 'A very large case'). The T20 drill-down returns every line of a figure in one response. Total money in (M17) on a 10,000-line statement took 2.29s and produced a 0.9 MB page. Paging needs a design choice (page size, how a sum figure's total is shown beside a page of its lines), so it is left as a gap, not fixed here; it may belong with T22's timed recompute.
